none: PAS HESH-0FD355: Early Medieval Coin: Sceatta
contea di ritrovamento: Shropshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An early medieval silver sceat, Primary Phase (c.680-710); series BIa-c copy (probably) with lettering not appropriate for BII (variety without cross in front of bird on reverse); c.695-700. Obverse: Diadem head right (double row of pellets in diadem) within circlet of pellets ending in horizontal V at 9 o'clock representing a snake. Inscription: [...]VIINOOAV[...]. Reverse: Bird sitting right on…
